literalIntent: Deliver LeeWay voice, vision, model, skills and Formula-governed behavior from GitHub/Pages to a device-local HTTP runtime, with inference executed on the user's device.

notDiscovering: XTTS-v2 sustained Android/Termux ARM64 memory and thermal behavior
Coqui dependency closure in Termux without PRoot
browser loopback permission support on target browser
Chatterbox Nano/Turbo/Multilingual actual ARM64 memory and thermal behavior
Chatterbox clone fidelity for Agent Lee speaker identity
Chatterbox native incremental streaming availability versus batch generation
enhance: portable Bash bootstrap independent of Termux
voice-provider benchmark matrix: XTTS vs Chatterbox Nano/Turbo/Multilingual

routeDecision.voice: Keep XTTS-v2 as the current verified provider; qualify Chatterbox Nano/Turbo/Multilingual behind the same HTTP provider interface and allow the Device Passport + hard gates + Veritas to select the local provider.
routeDecision.vision: device-qualified multimodal provider behind the same HTTP contract
routeDecision.shell: Bash-first; Termux is one Android host adapter rather than the canonical runtime.
